subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular source layout for `scripts/install.sh` now, and should the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` remain a generated single-file artifact?
rationale: The request is valid maintainability work on a stable setup surface, but current docs, tests, and website sync all assume one directly served shell script, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term artifact strategy.

options.title: Sponsor generated single-file installer
options.body: Approve a modular source layout only if it still publishes one tested `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact and updates the validation matrix in the same change.

options.title: Extract only during bug fixes
options.body: Use this issue as backlog context and split installer sections only when a concrete bug fix or validation improvement needs that boundary.

options.title: Keep installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the shell installer should remain single-file to minimize helper-loading and website-publishing risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor generated single-file installer
recommendation.body: Approve a modular source layout only if it still publishes one tested `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact and updates the validation matrix in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: Current path history connects `vincentkoc` to both installer behavior and website-installer sync, which are the two central decisions for this request.
